notes.title: Wishlist now! - Get notified for the Free Demo!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577195/9124a68605df32950f7ef47957a1b6d948d1bbdd.gif[/img]
[b]PackJack [/b]is here - a bite-sized TCG booster pack-opening rogue-like!

If you enjoy the thrill of pulling Trading Card Game cards from booster packs, PackJack is exactly for you! But unlike in real life, in PackJack you are able to chance the odds in your favor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577195/d008a8a2bfc6a83df5985507f61457253bd052e1.gif[/img]

We are planning to create a [b]free demo[/b], so you can check out the game! Make sure to put PackJack on your wishlist in order to get notified for the demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601690/PackJack/
